user.title: JustNimbus MQTT
user.description: Configure the MQTT topic prefix your JustNimbus device publishes to.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the JustNimbus MQTT broker.
data_description.port: TCP port of the JustNimbus MQTT broker (default: 1883).
data_description.topic_prefix: The root topic your JustNimbus device publishes to (default: justnimbus).
data_description.device_name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant.

reservoir.title: Reservoir ("zak")
reservoir.description: Pick a standard rainwater bag for the fill level / full sensor, or Custom to enter dimensions. Choose Unknown to skip — those sensors then stay unavailable until you set this via Configure.

data_description.reservoir_preset: Standard bag, Custom (use the boxes), or Unknown (fill level stays unavailable).
data_description.reservoir_length_mm: Bag length in millimetres (used only with Custom).
data_description.reservoir_width_mm: Bag width in millimetres (used only with Custom).
data_description.reservoir_height_mm: Bag height in millimetres — the water height at which the reservoir counts as full (used only with Custom).
data_description.reservoir_volume_l: Total bag capacity in litres — used as 100% for the fill level (used only with Custom).

abort.already_configured: A device with this host, port and topic prefix is already configured.

init.title: Reservoir ("zak")
init.description: Pick a standard rainwater bag, Custom (enter the boxes), or Unknown (the fill level / full sensor stay unavailable). A standard preset uses its own values and ignores the boxes.

data_description.reservoir_preset: Pick a standard bag to use its dimensions, or Custom to use the values below.
data_description.reservoir_length_mm: Bag length in millimetres (used only with Custom).
data_description.reservoir_width_mm: Bag width in millimetres (used only with Custom).
data_description.reservoir_height_mm: Bag height in millimetres — the water height at which the reservoir counts as full (used only with Custom).
data_description.reservoir_volume_l: Total bag capacity in litres — used as 100% for the fill level (used only with Custom).
